ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $O$ lies on line $AB$, $OE$ bisects $\angle AOC$, $\angle DOC=90^\circ$, and $\angle EOC=65^\circ$. Find the measure of $\angle BOD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $OE$ bisects $\angle AOC$,\\
we have $\angle AOC=2\angle EOC=2\times 65^\circ=130^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle BOC=180^\circ-\angle AOC=180^\circ-130^\circ=50^\circ$,\\
given that $\angle DOC=90^\circ$,\\
it follows $\angle BOD=\angle DOC-\angle BOC=90^\circ-50^\circ=\boxed{40^\circ}$.

method.method_draft: Use an oriented-direction approach. From the image, take OB as the 0° horizontal ray and OA as the opposite 180° ray; OC is above OB, and OD is below OB.
